name: dsh-coding-time
displayName: dsh-coding-time AI 编码活动时长(以及人类编写时长)（本地）
description: Local coding-activity timing for DeepSeek Harness: wall-clock active intervals per project (cwd), AI-added/deleted line accounting from real diff metadata, and optional human-edit timing. Everything stays on this machine under ~/.dsh.

scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),cp=require('node:child_process');const walk=d=>fs.existsSync(d)?fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>e.isDirectory()?walk(d+'/'+e.name):e.name.endsWith('.js')?[d+'/'+e.name]:[]):[];const files=[...walk('lib'),...walk('client'),...walk('integrations')];if(!files.length)throw new Error('no js files to check');for(const f of files)cp.execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',f],{stdio:'inherit'});console.log('check ok: '+files.length+' files');"
